name: Kor'gar
summary: Kor'gar is a Horde encampment established within Darkshore, claiming ground formerly known as Blackwood Den. It serves as a fortified forward foothold for orcish forces in the ancient night elf territory.

sections.title: A Horde Foothold in Darkshore
sections.body: Carved out of the territory historically held by the Blackwood furbolgs, Kor'gar stands as a fortified encampment for the Horde in northern Kalimdor. Where furbolgs once inhabited Blackwood Den, orcish grunts, shamans, and wolfriders now guard palisades and patrol the surrounding woods, asserting their presence in the shadowed reaches of Darkshore.

faq.q: What was Kor'gar before it became an outpost?
faq.answer: Kor'gar was originally known as Blackwood Den, a settlement and burrow belonging to the local Blackwood tribe of furbolgs before Horde forces occupied and fortified the position.
The outpost is manned by Horde forces under the command of Commander Drald, defended by Kor'gar grunts, wolfriders, and shamans.

faq.q: Are the Blackwood furbolgs still around the area?
faq.answer: Yes. Blackwood warriors and skirmishers, led by figures like Elder Brownpaw, remain active in the wilderness directly outside the outpost's boundaries.

angles.text: For the Horde, Kor'gar represents a vital strategic foothold carved straight out of hostile wilderness along the Darkshore coastline.
Alliance forces and night elves view the presence of Kor'gar as an intrusion upon native lands and a direct threat to the region's delicate balance.
